title: Oicho-Kabu
betGuide: Place a bet; two cards are dealt to you (the child) and two to the banker.
drawGuide: Draw a third card, or stand and settle against the banker.

tutorial.betControls: Enter your bet and place it
tutorial.actionButtons: Draw a third card or stand to settle
tutorial.results: Both kabu and the payout are shown here

hint.drawLow: Your kabu is low (0–3) — drawing a third card is favorable
hint.standHigh: Your kabu is high enough — standing is the basic play
